stanza: And we just can't have that, girl
'Cause it's a sad, lonesome, cold world
And a man needs a woman
To stand by his side
And whisper sweet words
In his ears about daydreams
And roses and playthings
And the sweetness of springtime
And the sound of the rain

daydreams.songTitle: It Might As Well Be Spring
daydreams.line: I'm as busy as a spider spinnin' daydreams
stanza: I'm as busy as a spider spinnin' daydreams
I'm as giddy as a baby on a swing
I haven't seen a crocus or a rosebud
Or a robin on the wing
But I feel so gay in a melancholy way
That it might as well be spring
It might as well be spring

daydreams.line: But the bamboo hangs heavy in the bondage of quicksilver daydreams
stanza: So the serpent slides slowly away with his moments of laughter
And the old washerwoman has finished her cleanin' and gone
But the bamboo hangs heavy in the bondage of quicksilver daydreams
And a lonely child longingly looks for a place to belong
